children: AMERICAS CARMART INC reported results for the 2026 quarter showing a sharp revenue decline and a wider loss versus the prior-year quarter, driven by reduced inventory purchases, lower retail sales and elevated charge-offs amid a strategic shift toward wholesale dispositions.
¹ Reported as “Total revenues”. ² Reported as “Net loss attributable to common stockholders”. ³ Reported as “Diluted loss per share”.
Revenue fell 57.3% year-over-year as the company sharply curtailed inventory purchases and originations.
Management shifted toward wholesale disposals of repossessed vehicles to accelerate cash conversion, increasing the wholesale mix.
Retail units sold declined 81.9% amid consolidation to 94 locations from 154 (60 dealerships consolidated) and reduced inventory turns.
Centralized collections rollout completed; collections were modestly lower and charge-offs rose during the transition.
Operational priorities include preserving liquidity by reducing capital expenditures, tightening underwriting and managing portfolio size pending financing.
